description: This PHP source file is a unit test class for the WorkShiftDao component within the OrangeHRM Employee Management System. It contains setup routines and multiple test methods to verify CRUD operations and related functions of the WorkShiftDao, including fetching, saving, updating, and deleting WorkShift entities, as well as retrieving associated employees.

classes.name: WorkShiftDaoTest
classes.description: A test class extending the base TestCase used to verify the functionality of the WorkShiftDao class. It sets up test fixtures and includes multiple test methods to assess the correctness of CRUD operations and related workflows involving WorkShift entities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by instantiating the WorkShiftDao object and populating test data fixtures from a YAML file before each test method runs.

methods.name: testGetWorkShiftById
methods.description: Verifies retrieving a WorkShift by ID returns the expected name and time properties.

methods.name: testGetWorkShiftList
methods.description: Checks that the DAO correctly returns a list of WorkShift objects according to specified filters.

methods.name: testSaveWorkShift
methods.description: Tests creating a new WorkShift and confirms its properties after saving.

methods.name: testEditWorkShift
methods.description: Verifies updating an existing WorkShift's properties results in correct data persistence.

methods.name: testDeleteWorkShifts
methods.description: Ensures that deleting specified WorkShifts returns the correct count of deleted records.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeListByWorkShiftId
methods.description: Checks that the method retrieves associated employees for a given WorkShift ID and validates their data.
